newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck sees rise in 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Merck sees rise in 1997 earnings.

text.p: German drugs group Merck KGaA on Wednesday said earnings would rise and sales would develop well in 1997 after profits and sales advanced in the first quarter of 1997.

The group said in a statement that net profit after taxes and minority interests rose by almost seven percent to 140 million marks ($83.3 million) in the first quarter of 1997, while operating profit grew 17 percent to 279 million marks.
The cash flow rose by 19 percent to 282 million marks, or 15 percent of sales, Merck said.
"The Merck Group expects a good sales development and a further earnings rise for the full year 1997. However foreign exchange will remain a potential risk factor all year," the statement said.
